viruses.notes: Figures are CANCER deaths only (includes_cancer = true); HPV has no acute-infection mortality. Annual series is cervical cancer deaths only (IARC treats 100% of cervical cancer as HPV-attributable); HPV also causes anal, oropharyngeal, penile, vulvar, vaginal cancers (~150 000 extra cases/yr in 2024 per IARC), so true HPV deaths are somewhat higher – no peer-reviewed global all-site HPV-attributable DEATH estimate found. An MDPI Pathogens 2025 paper cites 755,303 'HPV-related cancer' deaths in 2022, but that counts total deaths from HPV-related sites (incl. all head & neck), not attributable deaths – do not use. GLOBOCAN (350k in 2022) vs GBD (297k in 2021) differ ~15–20%; WHO/GLOBOCAN 2024 figure (279,583) is a big drop from ~350k (GLOBOCAN 2022) – likely GLOBOCAN 2024 method revisions rather than a real 20% fall in two years – flag; 2024 is now close to GBD 2021 (297k). A GBD 2021 women's-cancer paper (PMC12376056) states 'Cervical cancer mortality decreased from 350,600 to 296,700' – inconsistent with GBD 2019 1990 count of 184,527; not used. IARC 2018/2024 figures are incident cases, not deaths. HIV co-infection raises cervical cancer risk – potential overlap with HIV death counts is small. No CDC PHIL HPV EM found in search. Nobel 2008 and 1983/1984 dates from general knowledge + reference lists, official Nobel page not opened.

annual_estimates.source_name: J Thorac Dis 2026 (GBD 2021)
annual_estimates.quote: In 2021, RSV-attributable LRIs caused 31,525 deaths globally [95% uncertainty interval (UI): 23,348–41,871], largely among children aged <5 years (27,829; 95% UI: 20,300–37,354).

discovered.detail: First isolated from captive chimpanzees with colds ('chimpanzee coryza agent', 1955/1956); Robert Chanock isolated identical virus from infants in 1957 and named it RSV

vaccine.detail: First RSV vaccine (GSK Arexvy, adults ≥60) FDA-approved 3 May 2023; Pfizer Abrysvo 31 May 2023 (incl. maternal); infant monoclonal nirsevimab 2023

viruses.status_2026: Seasonal epidemics worldwide; vaccines (older adults, pregnancy) and long-acting infant antibodies rolling out since 2023. 2025–26 season data not checked.
fun_fact: First found in chimpanzees with colds in the 1950s
A failed 1960s vaccine made illness worse; the first RSV vaccine came in 2023
viruses.image_hint: https://phil.cdc.gov/Details.aspx?pid=2175 (TEM of human RSV, E. Palmer 1981, public domain); alt PHIL 276
viruses.notes: Major definitional conflict: GBD 2021 all-age 2019 = 94.9k, while Li et al. 2022 alone gives 101.4k for under-5s only (GBD 2021 under-5 in 2021 = 27.8k) – the Nair/Li RSV GEN estimates include community deaths and are ~2–4x GBD's under-5 attribution. Adult deaths are poorly estimated: no global all-adult death estimate found; Savic 2023 gives 33k in-hospital deaths in high-income countries alone (≥60), Shi 2020 14k global in-hospital ≥65 (UR 5k–50k) – true adult toll likely higher than GBD suggests. GBD 2021 value (31.5k) is depressed by COVID-19 NPIs and should not be extrapolated. RSV LRI deaths may overlap with influenza/pneumococcal co-attribution in GBD. Name on card: 'RSV' (full name 26 chars exceeds 24). Discovery year 1955 vs 1956 varies by source. 1960s vaccine trial: two vaccinated infants died per several reviews; one FDA slide deck notes a Merck trial without enhancement – check before using 'deaths' wording.
